tasks.task: In the Bourbon Library, check only the Bourbon style box, type 100 into the minimum proof box, and type 20 into the maximum pour price box.
tasks.expected: Exactly three pours remain — Copper Stakes Single Barrel, Old Bluff Bottled-in-Bond, and Full House Toasted (proof-100 Old Bluff and $20 Full House sit right on the boundaries and are included); High Card Rye (a rye) and Riverboat Reserve ($22) do not appear.

tasks.task: In the Bourbon Library with no filters set, apply the sort by pour price from low to high.
tasks.expected: Amber Creek Small Batch ($12) is listed before High Card Rye ($12) — the $12 tie breaks alphabetically — and Dead Man's Hand Barrel Proof ($26) is last.

tasks.task: In the Bourbon Library, type 200 into the minimum proof box, then clear it.
tasks.expected: With 200 entered, a friendly no-results state appears (no crash, no leftover rows); clearing the box brings all 8 pours back.

tasks.expected: The Bourbon Library page opens showing all 8 seeded pours, each displaying strength in the combined format like '92 proof (46% ABV)'.

tasks.task: Fill in and submit the online reservation form with a name and party details.
tasks.expected: The form accepts the input and shows a confirmation message that the reservation was received.
